description:
The role involves supporting solicitors across a broad range of commercial litigation and dispute resolution matters, including legal research and drafting, preparation for court proceedings, mediations and arbitrations, management of evidence and case files, liaison with clients, counsel and courts, and general legal and administrative support to the team.

Requirements:

- PCLL graduate or law degree holder required.
- Relevant experience in law firm preferred.
- Good organization skills, hardworking, attention to detail.
- Good command of written and spoken English and Chinese, including Cantonese and Mandarin.

Please send us with full resume with current and expected salary by email at recruitment@pclawyers.com.hk.
All applications will be treated in strict confidence. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.
